---
title: "Multiplied"
date: "2026-07-20"
categories: [news]
---

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(plotly)

# --- Data -------------------------------------------------------------

x_vals <- seq(0, 5, length.out = 400)
y_vals <- exp(x_vals)
df <- data.frame(x = x_vals, y = y_vals)

# Label positions
x_points <- c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
y_points <- exp(x_points)
y_points[length(y_points)] <- y_points[length(y_points)-1] * 0.8   # lowered last point

# Your modified y-values
y <- c(1.000000, 2.718282, 7.389056, 20.085537, 54.598150, 43.678520)
x <- 0:5

# Smooth curve (loess)
lo <- loess(y ~ x)
x_smooth <- seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = 400)
y_smooth <- predict(lo, x_smooth)

# --- Labels -----------------------------------------------------------

x_desc <- c(
  "fièvre",
  "pas de fruits",
  "petit reste",
  "guerre",
  "exil",
  "repentance"
)

hover_desc <- c(
  "Symptôme initial : fièvre",
  "Absence de fruits, ciel fermé",
  "Un petit reste subsiste",
  "Conflits, guerre",
  "Exil final",
  "Sabbat forcé"
)

# --- Curve segments ---------------------------------------------------

solid_part      <- subset(data.frame(x = x_smooth, y = y_smooth), x <= 3)
intermittent_1  <- subset(data.frame(x = x_smooth, y = y_smooth), x > 3 & x <= 3.5)
intermittent_2  <- subset(data.frame(x = x_smooth, y = y_smooth), x > 3.5)

# --- Plot -------------------------------------------------------------

p <- plot_ly() %>%

  # Solid curve
  add_lines(
    data = solid_part,
    x = ~x, y = ~y,
    line = list(width = 4, color = "#1B4F72"),
    name = "solid"
  ) %>%

  # Dashed segment
  add_lines(
    data = intermittent_1,
    x = ~x, y = ~y,
    line = list(width = 4, color = "#1B4F72", dash = "dash"),
    name = "dash"
  ) %>%

  # Dotted segment
  add_lines(
    data = intermittent_2,
    x = ~x, y = ~y,
    line = list(width = 4, color = "#1B4F72", dash = "dot"),
    name = "dot"
  ) %>%

  # Data points (visible)
  add_markers(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    marker = list(size = 10, color = "#2A6F9E"),
    name = "Data points"
  ) %>%

  # Invisible hover markers
  add_markers(
    x = x_points,
    y = y_points,
    text = hover_desc,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    marker = list(size = 20, opacity = 0),
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) %>%

  # Layout
  layout(
    title = "Loi des malédictions divines",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "degré de désobéissance",
      tickmode = "array",
      tickvals = x_points
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "niveau de sanction",
      range = c(0, 70),
      tickmode = "array",
      tickvals = seq(0, 60, by = 20)
    ),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )

# --- Add annotation boxes --------------------------------------------

for (i in seq_along(x_points)) {
  p <- p %>% add_annotations(
    x = x_points[i],
    y = y_points[i],
    text = x_desc[i],
    showarrow = FALSE,
    align = "center",
    xanchor = "center",
    yanchor = "bottom",
    bgcolor = "white",
    bordercolor = "#2A6F9E",
    borderwidth = 2,
    borderpad = 4,
    font = list(size = 14)
  )
}

p
```
